html:
The crisis that followed the Gambian presidential election of 1 December 2016, in which Adama Barrow defeated Yahya Jammeh.

Jammeh first conceded, then a week later rejected the result. Barrow was sworn in at the Gambian embassy in Dakar on 19 January 2017. Troops from Senegal and other members of ECOWAS crossed the border, and after talks led by the presidents of Guinea and Mauritania, Jammeh flew into exile on 21 January. A truth commission later heard testimony on killings under his rule. The peaceful handover was a turning point for the small country and a test for the regional bloc.
sum: The crisis that followed the Gambian presidential election of 1 December 2016, in which Adama Barrow defeated Yahya Jammeh.
